READ                                                    Traveller
   Read and answer the questions.



                                               Charlotte Everson is a 45-year-old mother and
                                            grandmother. She’s got a daughter and two grandsons.
                                                    She’s a very active woman. She goes jogging every morning.
                                      Then she has a shower and goes to work. She works from
                                                ten to six but she doesn’t go home after work. She goes to
                                               her daughter’s house and helps her with the housework. Of
                                                  course, she also plays with her grandsons. They all have
                                              dinner together and then she goes home. She goes to bed late,
                                               but she always gets up early.




     1. What time does Charlotte start work?



     2. When does Charlotte visit her daughter?



     3. Does Charlotte have dinner at her daughter’s house?



     4. Does Charlotte go to bed early?
